31 December
Hong Kong
New Year Countdown
A new year entails new hope and new beginnings. Welcome a new year in style with the Hong Kong New Year Countdown! Enjoy a myriad of spectacles, sharing positive energy and heartfelt blessings with thousands of revellers ringing in the new year together.
Stay tuned to the Hong Kong New Year Countdown and citywide countdown happenings, creating lasting memories with your loved ones!
